newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks drop on limited participation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks drop on limited participation.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed flat in dull trading on Thursday with small retail investors accounting for much of the activity, brokers said.
The Colombo Stock Exchange all share index closed 0.3 points lower at 622.5, moving down for a fourth day in a row.
John Keells Ltd gained two rupees to 36 rupees. Tea Smallholders dropped 1.25 to 25.25. Losers outnumbered gainers 25 to 17.
Turnover, supported mainly by a parcel of 65,000 National Development Bank, was 24.8 million rupees, well below Wednesday's 62.3 million rupees.
